question_text: Will the Nasdaq-100 be below 23700 at the end of Nov 14, 2025 at 4pm EST?
resolution_criteria:
If the end-of-day Nasdaq 100 index value on November 14, 2025 is below 23700, then the market resolves to Yes.
The market will close on November 14, 2025. The market will expire at the sooner of the first release of the data, or one week after November 14, 2025.
